title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
hook_text: Seven hundred forty billion dollars for AI infrastructure
script:
Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft plan to spend over seven hundred forty billion dollars on capital expenditures.
Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft are pouring massive funds into building data centers and chips.
Wall Street investors are pushing back as mounting debt and negative cash flow hit balance sheets.
TechCrunch reports that growing skepticism is forcing boardrooms to rethink long term returns on data centers.
Can Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft justify these massive hardware costs to their shareholders?
